title: Escarpment and Wreck
author: Beatrix Halloran
blurb: Ulyana Fairweather, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
